capabilities: Switches embedded vault images in live replies from lazy to eager loading
Leaves images in reopened chat history and user messages unchanged
Skips images it cannot identify as part of a live reply
Runs without modifying Claudian files, notes or saved chats
disambiguation: Not an image viewer or gallery; it only changes how Claudian's live replies load embedded vault images.
extras: Manual installation only; relies on Claudian's internal live-message markers and was verified only in Obsidian 1.15.1 on Windows with Claudian 2.3.30. Makes no network requests and collects no telemetry, and can be disabled without disabling Claudian.
intentEvidence: unofficial desktop Obsidian companion plugin for Claudian
problem: An embedded vault image in a live Claudian reply can hold back the completed/unread indicator when that reply sits in a background chat tab.

relations.evidence: unofficial desktop Obsidian companion plugin for Claudian

summary: Companion plugin for Claudian that switches embedded vault images in live replies to eager loading so background chats finish rendering.
